svg.title: A pile of bleached driftwood on a river gravel bar: seven barkless logs of different lengths and very different thicknesses lying ACROSS one another at seven different angles, none parallel, none stood up or leaned, none steeper than twenty degrees, among rounded cobbles. ATTEMPT SIX, 2026-09-24, AND WHAT IT CORRECTS: blind run 7e6b1463748d4299 read attempt five as A PILE OF BONES AND AN ANTLER. Its round-capped strokes gave every log a smooth knobbed end, which is the end of a long bone, and its root fan curved up and branched over a knob, which is an antler. So this build carries the incident a tree has and a bone does not, as SHAPES rather than surface texture (assets/style/the-north-level.md section 8.1 proposed exactly this): every end is BROKEN - a torn row of splinters of uneven length, a different profile on each end - never a rounded knob, never a flat sawn face and never a single whittled point; every log carries two to four grain CHECKS, short dark slivers running along its length, and one SPLIT opening from a broken end; three logs carry a SNAPPED LIMB STUB; the edges wander and swell rather than running true; and the root log's butt FLARES into four kinked roots of four lengths that run out low and down into the gravel on one side, thick at the flare and torn at the tip, with no fork, no knob and nothing curving back over itself. Each log takes all three tones of ONE of the `path`, `limestone` and `stone` ramps, weighted to the weathered greys (three `path`, three `limestone`, one `stone`): the light tone on the upper body with a wandering lower edge, the base tone below it and for the last stretch of each end, and the shade tone as a thin rim on the bottom edge and in the checks. No bark, no green wood, no saw cut, no tool mark, no point, no disc or ring. Natural debris and nothing else: no cairn, no inuksuk, no marker, no structure, no shelter, no fish weir and no figure at any scale - assets/style/the-north-level.md and docs/content-review.md. Drawn from the driftwood along the shore in assets/refs/the-north/yukon-river-bluff-and-aspen.jpg and the log jam on the bar in yukon-river-valley.jpg; see assets/refs/references.json, subject driftwood-pile. Generated from a centreline-and-thickness description of each log, so its numbers are coordinates rather than hand-placed points. POI hero, present at every visual tier.
